strings.name: Moxie Marlinspike
strings.role: Software developer · Communications privacy and encryption advocate
strings.summary: Marlinspike moved from software and security research into encrypted communications, co-founding Whisper Systems and working on security at Twitter. With Trevor Perrin and the open-source community, he advanced Signal's protocol and applications, then established the Signal Foundation with Brian Acton. After stepping down as Signal CEO, he created Confer for private AI conversations and announced collaboration with Meta.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His work on Signal and end-to-end encryption protocols helped spread private communications and secure messaging.
strings.facts.f1.label: Upbringing
strings.facts.f1.value: Grew up in Georgia, United States; moved to Silicon Valley in 1999.
strings.facts.f2.label: Early work
strings.facts.f2.value: Early software development work included BEA Systems and other technology companies.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Signal and a nonprofit foundation
strings.highlights.h1.text: Collaborators connected protocols, open applications and a foundation to make secure communication easier to use.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Privacy for AI
strings.highlights.h2.text: Confer explores encrypted conversations, confidential computing and protected file processing.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Confidential workers described
strings.timeline.t1.text: He explained how Confer uses trusted execution environments to process files and run programs.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Meta collaboration announced
strings.timeline.t2.text: He said he would integrate Confer privacy technology with Meta AI while Confer remained independent.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Introducing Confer
strings.timeline.t3.text: He continued privacy engineering through an encrypted service for AI conversations.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Signal CEO departure announced
strings.timeline.t4.text: He began a successor search and said he would continue supporting the project from its board.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Signal Foundation established
strings.timeline.t5.text: With Acton, he launched a nonprofit to sustain open communications-privacy technology.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Signal launches on iPhone
strings.timeline.t6.text: Open Whisper Systems released encrypted voice calling compatible with Android's RedPhone.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joining Twitter
strings.timeline.t7.text: He joined after its acquisition of Whisper Systems and helped open-source parts of the code.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Co-founding Whisper Systems
strings.timeline.t8.text: With Stuart Anderson, he developed mobile security tools including TextSecure and RedPhone.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Moving to Silicon Valley
strings.timeline.t9.text: After high school, he entered software work and developed security research and independent projects.
